name: Business Websites
headline: Your business, online and converting in *48 hours*.
promise: Most business websites are digital brochures nobody reads. We build the other kind: fast, server-rendered, engineered around one job — turning visitors into enquiries. Brief us at hour zero; by hour 48 you are live, indexed and measurable.

included.title: Conversion-engineered design
included.text: Every section exists to move a visitor toward contacting you. Clear offer, visible proof, one obvious next step — no decorative filler.

included.title: Server-rendered SEO
included.text: Your pages arrive as real HTML, not a JavaScript puzzle for Google to solve. Search engines index exactly what your customers see.

included.title: 90+ Lighthouse targets
included.text: We build to 90+ Lighthouse scores across performance, accessibility, best practices and SEO. Slow sites lose customers before the first word loads.

included.title: Structured data
included.text: Schema.org markup tells Google what your business is, where it operates and what it offers. That is how you earn rich results, not just blue links.

included.title: First-party analytics dashboard
included.text: Your own dashboard showing visitors, traffic sources and funnels — no third-party snooping, no spreadsheet exports. You see what is working from day one.

included.title: WhatsApp and lead capture
included.text: One-tap WhatsApp chat plus a lead form that lands enquiries where you will actually read them. Built in, wired up, tested before launch.

process.text: A focused call or written brief. We nail down your offer, your customers and the single action the site must drive. You hand over logo, photos and answers — we handle the rest.
We shape the page around your conversion goal: headline, proof, pricing, call to action. You review a live preview link, not a PDF mockup.
Server-rendered code, structured data, analytics, WhatsApp and lead capture — assembled and tested against our 90+ Lighthouse targets on real devices.
Domain connected, SSL live, sitemap submitted, dashboard handed over. Your site is public and already measuring its first visitors.

faqs.a: Yes — the clock starts the moment your brief is complete. The Launch plan is a one-page site with a tight, proven structure, which is exactly why it can move this fast. Larger builds get honest timelines: 4 days on Growth, 7 on Scale.

faqs.q: What do you need from me?
faqs.a: Your logo, a handful of photos and answers to a short brief — roughly 30 minutes of your time. If your photos are rough, we will tell you and work with what converts. No content? We write the first draft from your brief.

faqs.q: What if I need more than one page?
faqs.a: Move up a plan. Growth (₹14,999 / $189) covers up to 5 pages in 4 days with the full analytics dashboard; Scale (₹24,999 / $329) adds e-commerce or booking across up to 10 pages in 7 days. Same engineering standards on every tier.

faqs.q: Will my site actually show up on Google?
faqs.a: We cannot promise rankings — anyone who does is selling you something. What we do promise: server-rendered pages, structured data and clean indexing, so Google can read every word.

faqs.q: How do I know the site is working after launch?
faqs.a: Your first-party analytics dashboard shows visitors, where they came from and how they move toward contacting you. We hold ourselves to the same standard — our own live analytics and real-user Core Web Vitals are public at /proof. Check ours before you buy.

cta: Brief us today. Be live before the weekend.
